text:
Samir Gupta: Heads-up  candidate Noor A. is flying in tonight for the final loop (arrive 5:10pm). Noor mentioned they travel with a small certified service dog and need ground-floor hotel + quiet room. Need to confirm building access and pet relief.
Evelyn Park: Thanks Samir. Can you share airline ETA + whether they need pickup?
Samir Gupta: Flight lands 4:20pm at JFK, should clear by ~4:50. Prefers to take a rideshare but asked if we can pre-book a car due to the dog and luggage.
Maddie Li: We can book corporate car up to $90. Approve?
Evelyn Park: Approved. Use vendor car and note service animal in the booking. Also book a ground-floor room with no connecting doors.
Facilities: Noted re: service animal. We'll reserve a pet relief area by Loading Dock D and leave a temporary leash hook near Reception. Need ETA to set up sign and waste bags.
Reception: After-hours visitor protocol: drop at Main Lobby B, bring photo ID. Call desk at +1-555-414-7000 on arrival. We'll fast-track badge printing. Please inform us about the service animal so security can expect them.
Samir Gupta: I'll DM Noor the arrival instructions and vendor car details. Will share the driver's name when booked.
Maddie Li: Hotel suggestion: Riverside Business Inn ground-floor room, corporate rate $195. I can confirm booking.
Evelyn Park: Please proceed. Use corporate card and add folio link to the candidate itinerary.
People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted for Noor Ahmad. Badge ETA: 15 minutes after check-in. Reminder: For animals, we require documentation on arrival; please ask the candidate to have certification ready.
Samir Gupta: Noor said they have the certification PDF and can share it via email. I'll request it.
Maddie Li: Catering note: Noor is gluten-free + lactose intolerant. Kitchen will prepare GF boxed dinner with dairy-free option.
Facilities: We'll place a water bowl and waste bags at Loading Dock D and mark a 10-minute relief zone near the curb. Signage will be removable after visit.
Reception: When Noor arrives, please text "Noor A - arrived" to +1-555-414-7000 so we can expedite their badge. We'll also provide a printed visitor pass and a small map to the relief area.
Evelyn Park: Panelists  please confirm whether you need remote backup. We have Zoom fallback if the candidate is delayed.
Maddie Li: Zoom backup created and link added to the calendar invite.
Samir Gupta: Reimbursement process if Noor chooses rideshare: forward receipt to expenses@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Travel - Noor Ahmad - [date]". Reimb within 3 business days.
People Ops Bot: Expense template: "Expense Type: Candidate Travel; Amount: $XX; Candidate: Noor Ahmad; Approver: Evelyn Park". Create vendor-payment ticket for the car booking if used.
Facilities: Security note: please escort the candidate from Main Lobby B to Conf Room C3 due to after-hours access. Who will escort?
Evelyn Park: I'll meet at Main Lobby B at 5:00pm to escort. Adding a 4:55pm meet event for escorts.
Samir Gupta: Done  sent 4:55pm meet invite to Evelyn + Reception + Maddie.
Reception: We'll have the printed badge and visitor map ready. We'll also keep a spare leash hook and waste bag kit at the desk.
Maddie Li: Hotel booked and confirmation added to the invite. Voucher for vendor car sent to travel vendor.
Samir Gupta: I'll DM Noor the meeting spot, Reception number, and request the animal paperwork PDF. Thanks everyone.
Evelyn Park: Closing the loop  if anything changes ping here.
People Ops Bot: This thread will be archived after 7 days per channel retention settings.
